title.zh: 授权向 Cavite 省人口普查区主管佩罗伊·M·莫尔依法支付薪酬的法案，尽管其同时担任 Cavite 省财政厅长及人口普查资金拨款官员，并因此领取相应薪金与报酬

title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép chi trả thù lao theo pháp luật cho Peroy M. Moir với tư cách là Giám sát viên Tổng điều tra dân số cho khu vực gồm tỉnh Cavite, mặc dù ông là Kho bạc tỉnh Cavite và do đó là viên chức chi tiêu quỹ phục vụ tổng điều tra dân số cũng như nhận lương và thù lao cho chức vụ này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้จ่ายค่าตอบแทนตามกฎหมายแก่เปโรย์เอ็มโมร์ในฐานะผู้ควบคุมการสำรวจสำมะโนประชากรสำหรับเขตที่ประกอบด้วยจังหวัดกาบิตีแม้เขาจะดำรงตำแหน่งผู้เก็บเงินจังหวัดกาบิตีและเป็นเจ้าหน้าที่จ่ายเงินสำหรับวัตถุประสงค์การสำรวจสำมะโนประชากรและได้รับเงินเดือนรวมทั้งค่าตอบแทนสำหรับตำแหน่งนั้น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan pembayaran kompensasi sesuai hukum kepada Peroy M. Moir sebagai Pengawas Sensus untuk distrik yang meliputi Provinsi Cavite, meskipun ia adalah Bendahara Provinsi Cavite dan dengan demikian Pejabat Pengeluar Dana untuk keperluan sensus serta menerima gaji dan kompensasi atas jabatan tersebut
title.ms: Akta membenarkan pembayaran pampasan mengikut undang-undang kepada Peroy M. Moir sebagai Penyelia Banci bagi Daerah yang Merangkumi Wilayah Cavite walaupun beliau merupakan Bendahari Wilayah Cavite dan oleh itu Pegawai Pelupusan Dana bagi Tujuan Banci serta menerima gaji dan pampasan bagi jawatan tersebut

text.en:
The provincial treasurer of Cavite, in his capacity as disbursing officer of funds for census
purposes, is hereby authorized and directed to pay to Percy M. Moir the compensation provided by law for
the position of supervisor of census, under provisions of Act Numbered Four hundred and sixty-seven and its
amendments, notwithstanding the fact that the said Moir is the provincial treasurer of the Province of Cavite
and, as such, disbursing officer of funds for census purposes and receiving salary and compensation in both
of such last-named positions.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall be effective on its passage, but shall be retroactive in its effect so as to enable the
said Percy M. Moir to receive salary during his incumbency in the position named.
Enacted, April 8, 1903.
